info.description:
Enterprise Restaurant Reservation Platform — REST API (v1).

**Source of truth**: NestJS controllers under `apps/backend/src`, verified route-for-route by `scripts/verify-postman-coverage.ts` (AST-based, CI-suitable — see `npm run postman:verify`).

**Base URL**: `{{baseUrl}}` → `…/api/v1`

**Response envelope** (business endpoints unless noted):
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {}, "meta": {} }
```

**Structure**: four top-level business domains — `00 - System`, `01 - Customer`, `02 - Restaurant`, `03 - Platform Owner` — each subdivided by capability. An endpoint reachable by more than one actor type (e.g. a Customer or a branch-scoped Employee) is placed once, under its primary/canonical owner, with every supported actor documented in the request description rather than duplicated.

**Auth**: Collection Bearer defaults to `{{accessToken}}` (Restaurant Owner/Admin/Employee). Public requests set `noauth` explicitly. Every request under `01 - Customer` uses `{{customerAccessToken}}` explicitly; every request under `03 - Platform Owner` uses `{{platformAdminAccessToken}}` explicitly.

**Role labels** are documented on every request under **Required Role**.

Each backend route appears **exactly once** — verified 100% coverage, zero missing/extra/duplicate routes.

## Purpose
Request deletion of the authenticated Customer's own account
## Authorization
Bearer `{{customerAccessToken}}`.
Guards: JwtAuthGuard, SessionVersionGuard
## Required Role
Customer only - never reachable by Employee/OrganizationMember/PlatformAdmin actors, even though they are also User rows underneath.
## Headers
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- `Content-Type: application/json`
## Path Params
_None_
## Query Params
_None_
## Body
JSON body — DTO: `DeleteAccountRequestDto`
## Success Response
Envelope message: "Account deletion requested. You have until the grace period ends to cancel."
Body: `DeleteAccountResponseDto` — `scheduledAnonymizationAt` (ISO 8601).
## Behavior (ADR-014)
- Anonymization-in-place, never immediate physical deletion.
- Immediately revokes every DeviceSession/TokenFamily and bumps `sessionVersion` — every already-issued access token on every device is rejected on its very next request, not just on refresh.
- Auto-cancels any active waitlist entries.
- Rejected with 409 while any Pending/Approved reservation exists — cancel it first via the existing reservation cancellation flow, then retry.
- Irreversible anonymization executes automatically once `SystemConfiguration.anonymizationGracePeriodDays` (default 30) elapses, unless cancelled first via `POST /users/me/cancel-deletion`.
- Idempotent: repeating this call while a request is already pending re-verifies the password (so a stale/malicious caller can't probe schedule state without credentials) but does not reschedule, re-publish the event, or write a duplicate audit row.
## Error Responses
- **400**: VALIDATION_ERROR (missing/too-short password)
- **401**: AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN, AUTH_EXPIRED_TOKEN, AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS (wrong password)
- **403**: AUTH_ACCOUNT_LOCKED, AUTH_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, AUTH_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, FORBIDDEN (actor is not a Customer)
- **409**: OPEN_RESERVATIONS_BLOCK_DELETION
## Notes
- Controller: `UsersController`.`deleteCurrentAccount`
- Full path: `/api/v1/users/me`
- Callers: Customer only (actor-type gate enforced in the use case)

## Purpose
Cancel a pending account deletion request within the grace period
## Authorization
Bearer `{{customerAccessToken}}`.
Guards: JwtAuthGuard, SessionVersionGuard
## Required Role
Customer
## Headers
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
## Path Params
_None_
## Query Params
_None_
## Body
_None_ — no password required. A freshly-issued JWT (obtained by logging back in, since requesting deletion already revoked every prior session) is already proof of credential possession.
## Success Response
204 No Content (envelope skipped).
## Behavior
Idempotent: calling this with no pending deletion request is a silent success (still 204).
## Error Responses
- **401**: AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN, AUTH_EXPIRED_TOKEN
- **403**: FORBIDDEN (actor is not a Customer)
## Notes
- Controller: `UsersController`.`cancelCurrentAccountDeletion`
- Full path: `/api/v1/users/me/cancel-deletion`
- Callers: Customer only (actor-type gate enforced in the use case)

request.description:
## Purpose
Restaurant Dashboard Calendar. Returns a branch's reservations within a required, bounded `[dateFrom, dateTo]` date range (inclusive, against `reservationDate`), enriched with Table and Customer (User/Guest) display fields - one joined query, no N+1, served entirely by the existing `(branchId, reservationDate, status)` index. Ordered `reservationStartTime` ascending.

One endpoint serves all three calendar views - pick `dateFrom`/`dateTo` accordingly:
- **Day**: `dateFrom` = `dateTo` = the selected day, e.g. `dateFrom=2026-08-15&dateTo=2026-08-15`
- **Week**: `dateFrom` = week start, `dateTo` = week end, e.g. `dateFrom=2026-08-10&dateTo=2026-08-16`
- **Month**: `dateFrom` = month start, `dateTo` = month end, e.g. `dateFrom=2026-08-01&dateTo=2026-08-31`
## Authorization
Bearer `{{accessToken}}` (Employee actor).
Guards: JwtAuthGuard, SessionVersionGuard (no PermissionsGuard - this is a read, not a `reservations:*` mutation; see Notes).
## Required Role
Employee only, branch-scoped (empty `branchIds` on the JWT = restaurant-wide scope). A Customer or OrganizationMember actor is rejected with 403 - OrganizationMember has no direct REST read access to the Reservation resource in this API (mirrors every other `/reservations/*` route's own actor-type rule).
## Path Params
| Name | Variable | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| `restaurantId` | `{{restaurantId}}` | UUID path parameter |
| `branchId` | `{{branchId}}` | UUID path parameter |
## Query Params
- `dateFrom`, `dateTo` - REQUIRED, inclusive `reservationDate` range (max span 366 days)
- `status` - optional single-status filter
- `page`, `limit` - pagination
## Body
_None_
## Success Response
Envelope message: "Branch reservations retrieved successfully."
## Error Responses
- **400**: VALIDATION_ERROR (missing/invalid dateFrom/dateTo, dateFrom after dateTo, range exceeds 366 days, invalid page/limit)
- **401**: AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN, AUTH_EXPIRED_TOKEN
- **403**: FORBIDDEN (not an Employee), EMPLOYEE_BRANCH_NOT_ASSIGNED (Employee not assigned to this branch)
- **404**: NOT_FOUND (restaurant not found, or branch not found / belongs to another restaurant - IDOR-safe collapse)
## Notes
- Controller: `BranchReservationsController.list`
- Full path: `/api/v1/restaurants/:restaurantId/branches/:branchId/reservations`
- No new `reservations:*` permission was introduced for this route (TASKS.md Phase 8 §9: existing mutation permissions remain REST-command-only) - any branch-authorized Employee may read the calendar.
- Audit-driven addition (2026-08-10): a full repository audit found no existing restaurant-dashboard reservation list/calendar endpoint - every prior `GET /reservations*` route is Customer-ownership-scoped. This single date-range endpoint was added instead of three redundant `/calendar/day|week|month` routes.
